title: Vildmarken (Full)
description:
For use on our server.

Based on an updated Fabulously Optimized 6.2.3
body:
This modpack is just meant for users of our server, but anyone can use it if they want to.

Based on [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized) 6.2.3 with some updated and added QoL mods.
Specifically do this modpack enable use of distant horizons with shaders.

Mods updated:
* Iris (1.8.1)
* MoreCulling (1.0.1)
* Sodium (0.6.2)
* Sodium Extra (0.6.0)

Mods added:
* Antique Atlas
* Appleskin
* ArmorStatues
* BadhorseFix
* BetterPingDisplay
* Bobby
* Distant Horizons (2.2.1-a)
* Gravelminer
* InventoryTweaks
* Jade
* JadeAddons
* Jade: Your Reputation
* JEI
* Name Visibility
* No Telemetry
* PhysicsMod
* WaveyCapes
* (and dependencies of above)


Reese's Sodium Options have been removed, as it is not ready for the newer versions of the other updated mods.
